situation: Colleagues sorting out a train to a conference.
topic: What time is the first train from Leeds to London King's Cross on a Sunday?

text: First sunday train from leeds to kings cross anyone know what time trying to work out earliest I can get down for the conference
no idea sorry i've only ever done weekdays
Not sure. Sunday services are usually later than weekdays, but check the operator's site rather than take my word for it.
Ok ta I'll look later, I'm on the sofa with the telly on
Dont think I've ever been on a sunday one
Found the timetable but it's a mess lol. There's one at it just doesn't say which day it runs on
Roadworks on the ring road again, took me forty minutes. Did you get anywhere with the timetable?
Not really it has like 3 different columns and no key. Gonna ring them at 9
Ring them. The website's always the wrong one.
sorry scrolling back is it the sunday before the monday we're going down?
Yeah the 13th, conference is the monday 14th
ah ok thanks
Rang the national rail number on my break. First sunday one from leeds is after 8 apparently. Dont quote me the bloke sounded unsure
Ooh ta callum 🙏 so 8ish, that's fine
Worth booking advance fares early if you're committing. Sunday ones can be cheaper than you'd expect.
Will do thanks andrew
dentist ran over so i'm stuck here till 5 ugh
Oof sorry hope it's not bad
Booked the 13th, leaving leeds about 8ish. Will check the confirmation tomorrow in case I've got the wrong day lol
Nice one
Does anyone know if they're doing engineering works on the Sunday, or just the Saturday?
Confirmation just came through says 13th, 8:0x from leeds. Checked twice
No idea about works sorry andrew I'll check the national rail site
do we claim the train back as well or just the way down
Both, same expenses form. Keep the booking refs and the receipts. Send them to me once you've got them.
ok thanks
Going home at 5. Anyone want a lift to the station Sunday, I'm driving past it
Oh that'd be lovely thanks callum what time would you be leaving
How much do you pack for two nights lol. I've got three outfits and a suitcase that's basically empty
Just the one bag. Trust me
Lol ok
tooth still numb anyone know if you can eat with half a face
Ha no idea megan, soup?
Soup, and check the numbness passes in a few hours. If not, ring the dentist, don't use an online form.
